rationale: Avoid treating vocabulary-dependent embedding parameters as the sole cross-condition capacity coordinate; total trainable parameters will still be reported.
frozen_before_outcome_required: training corpus manifest and byte/provenance receipt
compute_rule: If equal-token training is infeasible, predeclare compute-matched and token-matched analyses separately; do not pool them into one capacity effect.

rival.requirement: No decoder-only next-token LM hidden inside the rival route.

prohibited: Increase only the failing checkpoint until it passes and call that confirmatory.
Change corpus/objective/tokenizer jointly with capacity and claim a capacity threshold.
Use external frontier LLM output as hidden training labels without a separately declared distillation experiment.
